summary: TOOL-1 Login with valid and invalid credentials
description:
As a customer, I want to sign in so I can access my account.

* Valid email and password → redirected to the account page, and the user's name shows in the navigation.
* Wrong password → an error message appears and the user stays on the login page.
* Empty fields → each shows a required-field validation message.
* Password field masks the input.

criteria.text: Valid email and password → redirected to the account page, and the user's name shows in the navigation.
Wrong password → an error message appears and the user stays on the login page.
Empty fields → each shows a required-field validation message.

cases.title: Sign in with valid email and password
cases.preconditions: <a registered customer account with a known email and password> exists. The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter the registered email in the email field.
Enter the matching password in the password field.
cases.expected: The user is redirected to the account page and the user's name is shown in the navigation.

cases.title: Sign in with a valid email and wrong password
cases.preconditions: <a registered customer account with a known email and password> exists. The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter the registered email in the email field.
Enter a password that does not match the account in the password field.
cases.expected: An error message appears (exact text not specified in the story) and the user stays on the login page; no redirection to the account page occurs.

cases.title: Submit the login form with both fields empty
cases.preconditions: The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
cases.expected: Both the email field and the password field each show a required-field validation message (exact text not specified in the story); the user is not signed in.

cases.title: Submit the login form with the email field empty
cases.preconditions: <a registered customer account with a known email and password> exists. The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter the account's password in the password field.
cases.expected: The email field shows a required-field validation message (exact text not specified in the story); the user is not signed in.

cases.title: Submit the login form with the password field empty
cases.preconditions: <a registered customer account with a known email and password> exists. The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter the registered email in the email field.
cases.expected: The password field shows a required-field validation message (exact text not specified in the story); the user is not signed in.

cases.title: Password input is masked while typing
cases.preconditions: The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Type <any password value> into the password field.
Look at the characters displayed in the password field.
cases.expected: The typed characters are masked and the password is not displayed in readable form.
